summary: Workflow expansion tested through public preview: 32/32 API cases passed (15 new + 17 existing); all 33 route/viewport checks passed at 1920x800, 390x844 and 360x780. Shared chat, studio edits, 2/5/8/15s thresholds, early wait-only, guarantees, insights, paused/site-excluded chat, payout destinations, campaign analytics and ledger work. Three frontend defects confirmed. AI, ad inventory, financial transfers/shipping and example datasets are intentionally SIMULATED/MOCKED; private session/CRUD/receipts persist in MongoDB. No application source changed.

ui_bugs.issue: After two recorded views at bid $0.02, changing campaign bid to $0.04 preserves correct UI spend $0.04 but exports country CPVV 0.04. CSV implies $0.08 spend for those two historical views. Export derives CPVV from current campaign.bid, not recorded event bids. All-campaign export also leaves CPVV blank by source review.

integration_issues.issue: Send, wait for ad, reload before threshold: no cancellation receipt exists for returned view ID, and balance stays unchanged. useChatFlow handles visibilitychange and React unmount only; reload does not run its unmount cleanup. Pending session charge is abandoned until overwritten/canceled. Test manually canceled only its own returned ID afterward.

Reproduced twice using a 1.5s delayed start response and immediate Overview navigation. Cleanup sends POST /api/charges/cancel with {id:null,reason:navigation}, producing 422 and browser console error. Once start resolves, a second valid cancellation succeeds and exactly one unpaid receipt is recorded; no incorrect payout or blocking UI error observed.

action_items: Add unload/pagehide cancellation with a reliable authenticated keepalive request; persist unpaid navigation receipt before abandoning the view.
Never cancel an unresolved start using a null ID; defer cancellation until the returned ID is available, preserving exact-once handling.
Derive recorded CSV country CPVV from historical credited event bids (weighted by paid views); handle mixed campaigns rather than using current campaign.bid.
Retest these three defects; no A/B allocation engine should be added.
critical_code_review_comments: components/chat/useChatFlow.js:11 cleanup checks remote/settled but not id, causing the reproduced null-ID 422. The effect lacks pagehide/unload handling, explaining missing reload receipts.
pages/AdvertiserAnalytics.jsx:20 uses campaign?.bid for CSV, while line17 correctly sums stored e.bid for spend. Historical financial exports consequently disagree with UI.
